fail_closed_rules: Call-level Jev error/timeout/not-real-typesafe: no rows written for that batch; the term's observations stay unlabeled and the export fails the term closed (note untouched).
Per post: answer missing, outside closed_set, or top probability < min_top_probability -> stored as UNKNOWN (excluded from slang-sense metrics; counted in sense_unknown_share).

question_template.instructions: Post {pid} in STATE.posts: is the term '{term}' used there in its slang sense (the recorded slang meaning in STATE, or a close slang variant/extension of it), or is it an unrelated same-spelling use (a name, school, team, company, product, ticker/token symbol, technical or scientific term, the literal ordinary word, part of another word, or another language)? Mentioning, explaining or asking about the slang term counts as SLANG_SENSE. Judge only post {pid}.

criteria.SLANG_SENSE: uses, mentions or discusses the term in its slang sense
criteria.OTHER_SENSE: unrelated same-spelling use (name, school, company, ticker, technical term, literal ordinary word, other language), not the slang sense

related: rebuilt-sense-anchored-v1: same question, but for terms with an operator definition the definition is passed as the anchor sense and a slang sense not in the definition counts as OTHER_SENSE (labels keyed by definition sha256).
